m: īḍ cl. 2. Ā. īṭṭe (2. sg. pres. īḍiṣe, Ved. īḻiṣe, pf. īḍe, fut. īḍiṣyate, aor. aiḍiṣṭa, inf. īḍitum, Ved. īḻe, &c.) to implore, request, ask for (with two acc.); to praise, RV.; AV.; VS.; R.; BhP. &c.: Caus. P. īḍayati, to ask; to praise, BhP.
īḍ ṭ, f. praise, extolling, RV. viii, 39, 1.
a: īḍ 2 A. (īṭṭe, īḍāṃcakre, aiḍiṣṭa, īḍituṃ, īḍita) 1 To praise; agnimīḍe purohitaṃ Rv. 1. 1. 1; śālīnatāmavrajadīḍyamānaḥ R. 18. 17; neḍiṣe yadi kākutsthaṃ Bk. 9. 57, 18. 15. 2 To implore, request, ask for (with two acc.); upasthāya mātaramannamaiṭṭa Rv. 3. 48. 3. — Caus. 1 To ask. 2 To praise.
